digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime auth and provider session binding
propositions: Add LLMRuntime auth/session capability type to accept provider-native credentials without serializing into config/request/cache/schema boundaries
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to receive and pass LLMRuntime into the single per-run ProviderSession builder, preserving RP-01 policy and client lifecycle ownership
Provider auth must fail explicitly before model request if missing or conflicting, with no fallback to anonymous, alternate principal, or cross-provider routes
Auth injection tests must prove exactly one Rebar-owned official client, one ProviderSession, one Agent operation, and credential material absent from config/snapshot/fingerprint/cache/output/logs
